limitations: CPU timings are elapsed wall durations, including blocking where present. frame_ns includes the existing 16ms pacing.
Enabled instrumentation overhead is included. Compare only matching build options, hardware, driver, assets, layout, camera and workload.
NOISY timing fields exceed the predefined 10% run-median spread threshold. Stable request counters are the fallback, not a speedup claim.
No GPU/per-pass timer exists. Extraction/submission are not separated in this architecture; render_ns includes ImGui, swap and CPU ray tracing.
Phase 06 request counters exclude ImGui GL calls, texture upload payloads and unobserved resource storage. Failed draws and repeated binds can be counted.
estimated_buffer_bytes and shadow estimates are not total CPU/GPU memory or driver committed allocation.
Startup duration excludes OS executable loading. Diagnostic captures occur after all timed samples.
Physics uses a separate deterministic reset-per-sample workload; frozen rendering samples contain zero Physics steps and time.

known_visual_defects.finding: Multisample sampler-state GL_INVALID_ENUM and width-by-width auxiliary color attachments versus width-by-height depth attachments remain in RenderTarget.
Triangle-input shadow geometry shaders still receive existing line-helper draws; integer picking target inherits blend/dither state. Original diagnostics retained.
Editor scene resolves offscreen but its ImGuiRender call is disabled, leaving presentation black; scene.bmp records actual rendered output without fixing presentation.

historical_audit: No audit finding is mapped by the active Phase 13 contract; current source and prior Phase 06 diagnostic ownership were used. No broad historical audit loaded.
comparison_policy: Common Phase 65 metrics use Phase 13. New per-pass metrics establish a separate secondary baseline at Phase 48.
